欲しいと思ってるに違いないけど――
わたしも欲しいと思ってるの！

だから、ええと
もらえると、とってもうれしいなって
――アピール？　って、これでいいのかな

もう少ししたら、結果発表なんだって
その後は解散しちゃうから
ちょっとさみしいけど――

お前に一つ聞かせたい話がある――
あのモゴックが根城にしていたガルドノック砦だが
無視できないほどの脅威となりつつあるようだ
MsgEn:
I have something I need to discuss with you...
Mogok has made Gardnox Fortress his stronghold.
It's becoming a threat we can no longer ignore.

MsgJp:
本当に聞かないでいるつもりか？
お前もよく知る、あのモゴックが根城にしている
ガルドノック砦についてだぞ
MsgEn:
You plan to ignore this warning?
Mogok's base is Gardnox Fortress-
you know the place well.

MsgJp:
オーク軍の要塞とも言えるあの砦で
闇の渦から現れた強力な魔物が
モゴックと手を組んだらしい
MsgEn:
In that fortress, which could be considered
the very center of the orc army, a powerful
foe emerged from the vortex of darkness
and seems to have joined forces with Mogok.

MsgJp:
モゴックだけでも手を焼かされるというのに
脅威が増えたとなっては――
ようするに、神殿が血相を変える
事態ということだ
MsgEn:
Mogok alone was already a handful, but
with this added threat... well, let's just say
the temple is in an uproar over the situation.

MsgJp:
覚者の筆頭であるお前も
当然、出撃するんだろう？
MsgEn:
As the foremost among the Arisen,
I can count on your assistance, of course?

MsgJp:
あり体にいえば、緊急事態だ
このままでは白竜様の身に
危険が及んでしまう
MsgEn:
To put it bluntly, this is an emergency.
If things continue like this,
Lord White Dragon will be in danger.

MsgJp:
このままでは白竜様が危険に――
何だって？　断られるとは思わなかったな
今のは――覚者が何のための存在であるか
考え抜いた上での答えか？
MsgEn:
If this continues, Lord White Dragon
will be in danger... What? I didn't expect
to be refused. Have you carefully considered
what it means to be Arisen?

MsgJp:
いいか、よく聞くんだ
以前にもこの白竜神殿を襲撃した
黒竜の覚者――
その姿が再び確認されたらしい
MsgEn:
Listen carefully. The Arisen of the
Black Dragon, who once attacked The
White Dragon Temple, has reportedly
been sighted again.

MsgJp:
おっと、勘違いするなよ
お前がヤツを倒したことは
レスタニアの人間なら誰でも知ってるさ
MsgEn:
Now, don't get me wrong. Everyone in
Lestania knows you defeated him.

MsgJp:
今回現れたのはその力の残滓、いわゆる"思念体"だ
元々が強大な力を持っていたがゆえに
思念体の域を超え、実体として
よみがえったかのようにふるまっているらしい
MsgEn:
What appeared this time is a remnant of
their power, a "phantom" or some such.
As a being who previously wielded great
power, it seems to have manifested itself
in our world, as if it has been revived.

MsgJp:
ヤツにとって最後の機会になるよう
粉々に打ち砕いてやれ
MsgEn:
Make sure this is its last chance.
Crush it.

MsgJp:
俺たちが竜の統べる世界に存在する以上
白竜様に再び危険が及ぶ可能性は
徹底的に排除しなきゃならん
MsgEn:
As long as we exist in a world ruled by Dragons,
we must thoroughly eliminate any possibility
of danger coming to Lord White Dragon.

MsgJp:
白竜様が試練をお与えになるそうだ
心して聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
I hear Lord White Dragon will bestow
a trial upon you. Heed his words well.

MsgJp:
そうか――
まぁいい
時間はいくらでもある
準備ができたら、いつでも話しかけてくれ
MsgEn:
I see. Well, no matter. There's plenty of time.
Speak to me when you're ready.

MsgJp:
それにしても、俺もえらくなったものだ
次代の竜となる覚者様に
試練への案内をするなんて――なぁ？
MsgEn:
Still, I've risen quite high myself... 
Guiding Ser Arisen, the next Dragon, 
to their trial.
Quite an honor, don't you think?

MsgJp:
次代の竜を担うにあたって
最後の試練、との話だ
きっと想像もできないような困難が
待ち受けていることだろう
MsgEn:
This last trial awaits only those who bear
the mantle of becoming the next Dragon. 
No doubt, unimaginable hardships await ahead.

MsgJp:
――覚悟はできているんだな？
それじゃあ、向かうとするか
現地までは俺が案内しよう
MsgEn:
Are you prepared?
Well then, let's head over.
I'll lead you there.

MsgJp:
ここだけの話ですが
覚者様に、ぜひ"ご紹介したい依頼"があるんです
――その、あまり腕の立たない方には
ご紹介できない依頼、でして――
MsgEn:
This is just between us... I have a
"special request" I'd like your help with...
You see, it's not the sort of job
I could offer to anyone off the street...

MsgJp:
ご紹介したい"依頼"があるんです――
多少、"危険な依頼"なのですが
覚者様ほどの方であれば――
MsgEn:
There's a "special request" I'd like
you to take care of... 
though it carries "considerable risk".
But for a capable Arisen, like you...

MsgJp:
《ワイルドハント》から
いくつか依頼をご紹介いたします！
MsgEn:
I have some tasks to present 
to you on behalf of the 《Wild Hunt》!

MsgJp:
流石の腕前ですね！
今回の依頼、実はワイルドハントの中でも
《Sランク》に値する珍しい討伐対象だったんです！
MsgEn:
Remarkable work, Ser! 
This task involved a rare
《S Rank》 foe within the Wild Hunt!

MsgJp:
依頼にはそれぞれランクがあるのですが
Sランクともなると、もう一目見ただけで
「普通とは違う！」とわかるような
珍しい魔物が対象になりますよ
MsgEn:
Every request is given a rank, and for S Rank, 
you'll know at a glance, "This isn't normal!" 
The target is often a rare monster.

MsgJp:
高ランクの依頼は報酬も良い分
なかなか回ってこないのが難点ですが――
ワイルドハントの実績を積めば
優先的に回ってくるようになるかもしれません
MsgEn:
High-rank requests offer better
rewards, but rarely come your way...
Though proving yourself in Wild Hunts
may get you priority access.

MsgJp:
依頼は毎日数件届きます
宿屋によるついでにでも
ぜひ覗いてみてくださいね！
MsgEn:
Requests arrive daily.
So when you're at the inn,
don't forget to have a look!

MsgJp:
魔物にも個性というものがあるのをご存じですか？
わかりやすいところだと体の色や大きさなんかが
違ったりするようです
――私たちがそれに気付くことは稀ですけれど
MsgEn:
Did you notice monsters have their own
personal attributes? Obvious differences
include color and size variations...
 Though we rarely notice such details.

MsgJp:
そんな個性が一際強く発現して
強力に育った魔物――そういった魔物の
討伐依頼を《ワイルドハント》と呼び
腕の立つ方だけにご紹介しているんです
MsgEn:
Monsters whose traits manifest in unique ways 
can grow into powerful beings...
Such creatures are the focus of 
《Wild Hunt》 requests, and we only offer
these to the strongest adventurers.

MsgJp:
ちょうど今、１件依頼が舞い込んできています
覚者様の腕前なら
私も安心してご紹介できるのですが――
これを機に、いかがでしょう？
MsgEn:
A request has just come in. 
Given your abilities, Ser, 
I can offer it with confidence... 
Would you like to take it on?

MsgJp:
危険な分、報酬もなかなかなんですよ
依頼を達成し、きちんと報告していただければ
たくさんのプレイポイントをお渡しいたします
討伐するだけでなく、報告までセットでお願いしますね
MsgEn:
The risks are high, but so are the rewards.
Complete the task and report back,
and you'll earn a heap of Play Points.
Remember, it's not just about the hunt,
reporting is essential too!

MsgJp:
そうそう、ワイルドハントは危険な依頼ですから
クエストが破棄された場合、すぐに次の方へ
依頼を回すようにしているんです
MsgEn:
Indeed, the Wild Hunt's tasks are quite dangerous,
so if a quest is abandoned,
we promptly assign it to the next
available candidate.

MsgJp:
ですので、依頼を破棄されると、その日のうちに
同じ依頼を受け直すことはできなくなります
間違って破棄しないようにご注意ください
MsgEn:
As such, if you cancel a request,
you won't be able to accept
the same one again that day.
Please take care not to
discard it by mistake.

MsgJp:
ちょうどお前に話したいことが――
――いや、戦況については
ジョゼフから聞いているぞ
MsgEn:
There's something I wanted to talk to you about...
Actually, I've already heard about
the situation on the battlefield from Joseph.

MsgJp:
それを踏まえた上で
オレからも伝えたいことがある
"竜の力を帯びた武具"について、だ
MsgEn:
With that in mind, 
I found some interesting information. 
It's about "equipment imbued with dragon's power."

MsgJp:
"竜の力を帯びた武具"
――"竜武具"を鍛える方法について
ずいぶん調べてみた
お前にも、わかったことを話しておきたい
MsgEn:
"Equipment imbued with dragon's power"...
I've done quite a bit of research on how
to forge these "Dragon Arms." 
I want to share what I've discovered with you.

MsgJp:
まずは強化だが――
これについては、オレよりもソニアが詳しい
詳しい者に任せた方がいいだろう
MsgEn:
First, about enhancements...
Sonia knows a bit more than I do about this.
Better to leave it to the expert.

MsgJp:
なに、ソニアは良いポーンだ
多少複雑な武具だろうと
これまで通り上手くやってくれるはずだ
MsgEn:
Indeed, Sonia is a reliable pawn.
Regardless of how intricate
the gear might be, she'll
manage it with no issue.

MsgJp:
次に、強化に使う素材だ
武具を手に入れた場所には、武具と同じように
竜の力を帯びた素材があるはずだ
こいつを集めればいい
MsgEn:
Next, materials for enhancement.
Where you found the arms, there
should be materials imbued with
dragon's power, just like them.
Gather them.

MsgJp:
素材を集めるには、もうひとつ方法がある
それが"資源分解"だ――
竜の力を帯びた武具が余っていたら
オレのところに持ってきてくれ
MsgEn:
There's another way to procure
materials - "Equipment Disassembly".
If you have spare arms imbued
with dragon's power, bring them to me.

MsgJp:
そいつを分解して素材に変えてやることができる
少々荒っぽいが、多少は負担が減るはずだ
MsgEn:
I can break it down and turn it into materials.
It may not seem like the best choice at first,
but it should ease your burden and net you
some useful items.

MsgJp:
最後に、竜の力を帯びた"防具"の生産について――
これは、数は必要だが素材さえあれば作ってやれる
どうしても足りない防具ってのが出てくるだろう
そういう要望にも応えるから、遠慮はするな
MsgEn:
Finally, producing Armor with dragon's power...
I can craft it given enough materials,
though the quantities are large. When you
face shortages, make sure to disassemble items.

MsgJp:
竜の力を帯びた"武器"の生産については
ソニアに任せるとしよう
オレが一手に引き受けるには
少々荷が重い
MsgEn:
As for the production of "weapons" imbued
with dragon power, I will leave that to
Sonia. It's a bit too much for me to take
on entirely by myself.

MsgJp:
――む、一息に話しすぎたか？
ジョゼフのやつに話が長いと言われて
気を付けたつもりだったんだがな
MsgEn:
-Ah, I've been rambling, haven't I?
I meant to be careful since Joseph
said I can be a bit long-winded.

MsgJp:
"竜の力を帯びた武具"を
強化するための素材を得るには
武具を得た場所で拾ってくるか
そういった武具を"資源分解"するかだ
MsgEn:
To acquire materials imbued with dragon's power,
you can either gather them from the location
where you acquired that equipment
or break down imbued weapons through
"Equipment Disassembly."

MsgJp:
竜の力を帯びた"防具"を生産したいなら
素材を揃えてくれれば、オレが作ってやれる
MsgEn:
If you wish to forge armor with the 
power of dragons, just collect the materials,
and I will craft it for you.

MsgJp:
だが、強化や"武器"の生産については
ソニアに聞いてくれ
彼女は良いポーンだ
きっと上手く手配してくれる
MsgEn:
That being said, for enhancements
and weapon production, talk to Sonia.
She's one of our more reliable pawns,
she'll sort you out.

MsgJp:
何だ、急ぎの用でもあるのか？
一刻も早く伝えた方が良いと思ったんだが――
用が済んだら、また声をかけてくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, pressing matters elsewhere?
I wanted to tell you this as soon as I could...
Return once your current business is sorted.

MsgJp:
ええ、話は伺っております
竜の力を帯びた素材があれば
特殊な武具を強化することもできましょう
MsgEn:
Yes, I understand what you mean. 
If you possess materials with the 
power of dragons, we can strengthen 
special weapons too.

MsgJp:
強化することで、武具に秘められていた
竜の力を引き出す――といったことも可能なはずです
MsgEn:
Through enhancement, we can unlock
the hidden dragon's power sealed within
the weapons, allowing us to harness it.

MsgJp:
武具と素材が集まった際には
ぜひともクラフトルームへおいでください
私たちポーンも、その時を心待ちにしております
MsgEn:
Once you've gathered the equipment and materials,
do make your way to the Craft Room.
We pawns look forward to seeing you there.

MsgJp:
いよいよ、といったところだな――
オレも、オレなりに黒竜と戦うにあたって
覚者に何が必要なのか考えてみた
MsgEn:
At last, we've arrived at this point...
I've tried to consider what's
needed for the Arisen to fight
against the Black Dragon in my own way.

MsgJp:
武具を鍛える者として
覚者隊の統率たるお前にも
ぜひ伝えておきたい
MsgEn:
As a smith, I want to ensure you,
the commander of the Arisen,
is informed of this as well.

MsgJp:
覚者が黒竜に立ち向かうには
やはり竜の力が不可欠だ
――だが、黒竜は他の大陸を侵攻し
もはや他の竜を凌ぐ力を持っているだろう
MsgEn:
To stand against the Black Dragon,
the Arisen needs the power of dragons.
However, the Black Dragon has conquered
other lands, and likely exceeds
all other Dragons in strength.

MsgJp:
では、黒竜に対抗できる力は
もうこの世に存在しないのか？
そうは考えたくない――まだ諦めたくはない
MsgEn:
So, is there no power in this world
that can oppose the Black Dragon?
I refuse to believe that... 
I'm not ready to accept defeat.

MsgJp:
――黒竜が全ての闇を統べるというのなら
全ての竜で対抗すれば望みがあるのではないか
いや、全ての竜の力で対抗するよりほか
ないのではないか
MsgEn:
If the Black Dragon rules all darkness,
then harnessing every Dragon's might
may be our only hope. No... it must be our
sole focus.

MsgJp:
これがオレの答えだ
――つまり、オレにできる最大の協力は
竜の力の宿った武具を合成し
よりその力を高めていくことだと考えたわけだ
MsgEn:
This is my answer-
the ultimate aid I can provide
is forging gear bearing dragon power
and continuously enhancing it.

MsgJp:
だから、竜の力の宿った武具を集めておいてほしい
間違っても捨てたり売ったりしないようにな
分解する時も気を付けてくれ
MsgEn:
Therefore, I want you to collect
equipment that holds dragon power.
Don't discard or sell them by mistake. Be sure
to handle them with care when disassembling.

MsgJp:
む――
いや、これを伝えるのは
最早オレの義務といってもいい
聞く気になるまで、待ってるからな！
MsgEn:
Hmm... No—this is something
I must tell you, no matter what.
I'll wait until you're ready to lend an ear!

MsgJp:
覚者様、この闇の力を帯びた装具について
最後にもうひとつお伝えしたい事があります（仮）

それは、黒竜を討伐するための加護を入手する方法です――
黒竜は非常に強大な力を持っており
竜の加護が無くては討伐は非常に困難だと予想されます（仮）

そこで、私たちは黒竜に効力のある竜の加護について調べ
入手する手段を見つけ出しました――（仮）

詳しい内容については、彼に聞いた方が良いでしょう
覚者様、このクラフトルームにいる《竜スキル合成（仮）》という
人物をお訪ね下さい――
そこで全てを知ることができます（仮）

覚者様、お待ちしておりました――
黒竜に対抗すべく加護の入手方法についてお話します（仮）

その加護の入手方法とは――
全竜の加護をひとつにまとめることです
黒竜とは全ての闇を総べるもの――
その力に対抗するためには全ての竜の力が必要になります（仮）

ゆえに覚者様には、器となる装具と
全ての竜の加護を取り揃えて頂く必要があります
また注ぐ力は大きければ大きいほど
黒竜への効力も強大となります（仮）

険しき道となりますが
必要な時が来たときには
わたくしをお訪ねください（仮）

覚者様、このクラフトルームにいる《竜スキル合成（仮）》という
人物をお訪ね下さい――
そこで全てを知ることができます（仮）

覚者様、この闇の力を帯びた装具について
最後にもうひとつお伝えしたい事があります（仮）

黒呪の迷宮の
新たな道をご案内する時がきたようです
MsgEn:
The time has come to guide you
through a new path in the Bitterblack Maze.

MsgJp:
"深淵"――
より深く、より困難な道となるでしょう
船着き場から西にある、細い通路を抜けた先に
入り口が開かれています
MsgEn:
The "Abyss"... 
A deeper, far more treacherous path. 
West of the docks, past a narrow passage, 
lies its entrance.

MsgJp:
そちらでは、リュシアンという男が
わたしと同じようにご案内いたします
何なりとお申し付けください
MsgEn:
There, a man named Lucien
will guide you, just as I do.
Please feel free to ask him
for anything you may need.

MsgJp:
もちろん、"深淵"に挑まれるかどうかは
覚者様のご意思次第
わたしもリュシアンも
ただあなたの選択をお待ちするのみ――
MsgEn:
Of course, whether you choose to 
challenge the "Abyss" is entirely 
up to your will, Ser. Both Lucien 
and I will simply await your decision...

MsgJp:
ええ、それが覚者様の選択であれば
わたしはいつでもこの場にて
お待ちしております
MsgEn:
Yes, if that is your choice, Ser.
I will always be here, waiting for you.

MsgJp:
ここからでも十分に分かる――
これまでの黒竜とも異なる、さらに凶悪な
存在になっているということだ
MsgEn:
Even from hence, 'tis clear enough...
This Black Dragon differeth from the foes of old,
being a more fell and wicked being.

MsgJp:
心してかかるがよい
――我が覚者よ
MsgEn:
Mark well and gird thy soul—
... My Arisen.

MsgJp: ――来たか
MsgEn: ... So, you have come.

MsgJp:
白竜様から、お前ら覚者を集め
黒竜のいる地へ案内する役目を
仰せつかっている
MsgEn:
The White Dragon has assigned me
to gather you Arisen and lead you
to where the Black Dragon dwells.

MsgJp:
三度復活を経た竜――相当な力を持つことは
誰もが分かっている
――勝って帰ってこい
白竜様の力を継ぐ者としての、最大の任務だ
MsgEn:
A dragon revived thrice...
Its formidable power is undeniable...
Return victorious, Arisen.
This is your paramount duty
as heir to the White Dragon's might.

MsgJp: 【ヒント：エクストリームミッション解放】
MsgEn: 【Hint: Extreme Missions Unlocked】

MsgJp: エクストリームミッション解放クエストが受注可能になりました
MsgEn:
The Extreme Mission unlock quest is now 
available for you to undertake.

MsgJp: 白竜神殿のセネカに話しかけましょう
MsgEn: Talk to Seneka at the White Dragon Temple.

MsgJp: 【ヒント：更なる厄災の兆し】
MsgEn: 【Hint：Further Signs of Misfortune】

MsgJp: 白竜が何か不穏な気配を感じたようです
MsgEn:
It seems the White Dragon senses 
some unsettling presence.

MsgJp: 謁見の間に向かい白竜に話しかけましょう
MsgEn:
Head to the audience chamber and 
speak with the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
覚者さま――実は最近、覚者のみなさまや
人間の方々が食べるものに興味があるんです
もしよろしければ《<ITEM 9407>》を
１ついただけませんか？
MsgEn:
Master―― I have recently developed an 
interest in the food that you Arisen 
and humans consume. If you wouldn't 
mind, could you please spare one 
《<ITEM 9407>》?

MsgJp:
人が食べる物って美味しいのかな――って
最近、ちょっと気になってて――
も、もし良かったら

罠のある場所を教えるから
探しに行ってくれないかな？
MsgEn:
I'll point out the places with traps, 
so could you go investigate?

MsgJp:
罠のある場所を教えるから
探しに行ってくれないかな？
MsgEn:
I'll point out the places with traps, 
so could you go investigate?

MsgJp:
心配であわてて――
アタシ何も持たずに来ちゃった
MsgEn:
I rushed here in a panic,
and didn't bring anything with me.

MsgJp:
<NPC 581>が――
無事に見つかってよかった！
もう少しで敵に連れてかれる所だったんだね
MsgEn:
<NPC 581> was found safe and sound! 
I'm glad you made it back! 
You were almost taken by 
the enemy, weren't you?

MsgJp:
あとは自分で戻ってこれると
思うから、アタシ待ってます
手伝ってくれて、ほんとにありがとう！
MsgEn:
I believe I can return by myself, 
so I will wait here. Truly, thank you 
for your assistance!

MsgJp:
あ、隊長！
いいところに来たね！
MsgEn:
Ah, Captain!
You've come to the right place!

MsgJp:
実は、たった今いい作戦を思いついてね
城の兵たち何人かに頼みたいことがあるんだ
MsgEn:
To be honest, I just had a brilliant idea. 
I need to ask a few of the castle guards 
for something.

MsgJp:
でも、この展望城――
城の人間が迷うくらい広くて複雑だからね
人探しも大変なんだ
MsgEn:
However, this Lookout Castle―― 
is so wide and intricate that even 
the castle's residents get lost, 
making it hard to find anyone.

MsgJp:
ボクが作戦を忘れないうちに
急いで探したいんだけど
隊長も手伝ってくれないかな？
MsgEn:
I want to search quickly before I forget the 
strategy; could the captain 
lend a hand as well?

MsgJp:
ありがとう！
やはり、いつだって頼れるのは隊長だけさ！
MsgEn:
Thank you!
After all, you can always count on the captain!

MsgJp:
僕が探している兵たちは――
<STG 451>のどこかにいるはずさ
MsgEn:
The soldiers I'm looking for-- 
they're somewhere in
<STG 451>

MsgJp:
あぁ！　早くしないと
さっき思いついたばかりの作戦を
もう忘れてしまいそうだ！
MsgEn:
Ah! I need to hurry, or I'll forget 
the strategy I just came up with!

MsgJp: 急いで探す
MsgEn: Hurry up and search

MsgJp: ――少し待ってほしい
MsgEn: ... Please wait a moment.

MsgJp:
よし！　早速兵たちを探そう！
どこにいるか分からないから
周囲をよく見ながら探さないとね！
MsgEn:
All right! 
Let's find the soldiers as soon as possible!
We don't know where they are, 
so we have to look around carefully!

MsgJp: さぁ、時間との勝負だ！　隊長！
MsgEn:
Let's go, it's a fight against the clock! 
Captain!

MsgJp:
いやぁ、危うく全部忘れるところだったよ
あんな作戦、もう二度と思いつけないと思ったからね！
ありがとう隊長！
MsgEn:
Wow, I nearly forgot it all! 
I thought I could never devise 
such a strategy again! Thanks, Captain!

MsgJp:
あんな――あれ？
ええっと、確かなんか作戦が――あって
それが――どうとか――
MsgEn:
Oh... what?
Well, there was some kind of a plan...
that... that... was...

MsgJp: 隊長！
MsgEn: Captain!

MsgJp:
安心したら、きれいサッパリ忘れてしまったよ！
こいつはケッサクだね！
MsgEn:
I felt at ease and completely lost it! 
This is quite the marvel, indeed!

MsgJp: あっ
MsgEn: Oh

MsgJp: あっはっ
MsgEn: Ah, ha.

MsgJp: あっはっはっ
MsgEn: Ahahaha!

MsgJp: あっはっはっはっ！
MsgEn: Ahahahaha!

MsgJp:
そもそも、なんで隊長がここに？
おかしいな、まったく思い出せないぞ
MsgEn:
Why is the captain here in the first place?
It's crazy. I can't remember it at all.

MsgJp:
しかたない、一旦キャンプに戻ろう
お気に入りのオブジェを眺めていれば
そのうちきっと思い出すさ！
MsgEn:
It can't be helped; let's return to camp. 
If I admire my favorite object, 
I'll definitely remember it soon!

MsgJp: 隊長！　忘れないうちに早く探そう！
MsgEn:
Captain! 
Let's find them quickly before we forget!

MsgJp: なんとか間に合ったよ！　ありがとう隊長！
MsgEn:
I managed to make it in time! 
Thank you Captain!

MsgJp: やばい――やばいぞ隊長！　記憶が薄れてきた！
MsgEn:
Oh no - this is bad, Captain!　
My memory is fading!

MsgJp: 隊長――どうやら、間に合わなかったようだ――
MsgEn: Captain -- it seems we weren't in time --

MsgJp:
よし、<STG 451>で待ち合わせをしよう！
ボクもすぐに行くよ！
MsgEn:
Great, let's meet at <STG 451>! 
I'll be there shortly!
Ah--

MsgJp:
隊長、ボクの記憶は
ちょっと待てなかったようだ！
MsgEn:
Captain, it looks like my memory 
couldn't hold on for a moment!

MsgJp:
すまないが、また思い出した頃に
よろしく頼んだよ！
MsgEn:
I apologize, but when I remember, 
I'll ask for your help again!

MsgJp:
探してる兵たちは、皆<STG 451>にいるが
どこにいるか分からないから
周囲をよく見ながら探さないとね！
MsgEn:
The soldiers I'm searching for are in 
<STG 451>, but since their location is 
unknown, we need to search the area!

MsgJp:
一歩進めば作戦を１つ忘れてしまいそうだ！
さ、急いで探しに行こう！
MsgEn:
With every step, I feel like I'll forget 
another part of the strategy! 
Let's hurry up and search!

MsgJp:
よし、<STG 451>で待ち合わせをしよう！
ボクもすぐに行くよ！
MsgEn:
Great, let's meet at <STG 451>! 
I'll be there shortly!

MsgJp:
はぁ――妙な作戦だが――
言いたいことはわかった
MsgEn:
Well, it's an odd strategy, but I 
get what you mean.

MsgJp:
まぁ任せとけよ
"見分け方"なら大丈夫だ
MsgEn:
Well, don't worry; I can handle 
the "methods of identification."

MsgJp:
俺たちにとって、大事なのは作戦の内容じゃない
"ソネル様が考えた作戦"っていう
事実だけなんだ
MsgEn:
To us, the crucial part isn't the 
strategy's content, but simply the 
fact that it's "the plan from Ser 
Sonel."

MsgJp:
これはまたすごい作戦ですね
さすがはソネル様！
MsgEn:
This is an incredible plan, 
just as one would expect from Ser Sonel!

MsgJp:
"わら"がたくさんある場所は
いくつか心当たりがありますから
仲間をかき集めて探しますよ
MsgEn:
I know a few spots with plenty of 
"straw," so I'll gather our allies and 
start searching!

MsgJp:
ソネル様の作戦に疑問を持つ兵などおりません
そうやってここまで戦ってきたのですから
MsgEn:
There are no soldiers who question Ser 
Sonel's strategy, for we have come this 
far by following it.

MsgJp: 聞いただけで鳥肌が立ちそうな作戦ですね！
MsgEn:
This plan sounds so intense it gives me 
goosebumps just listening to it!

MsgJp:
ただ私、ちょっとあの見た目が苦手なんです――
でも、なんとかがんばって集めたいと思います！
MsgEn:
I have to admit, that appearance makes me 
uncomfortable, but I'll try my best to collect 
them!

MsgJp:
だだ、だいじょうぶです！
直接見ないようにすれば――
MsgEn:
No, it's okay!
If you don't look directly at it--

MsgJp:
でも、それじゃあ
さすがに危ないでしょうか――
MsgEn:
But is that truly safe, I can't help but 
wonder――

MsgJp: なにやらソネル様の様子が変なんだ
MsgEn: There's something strange about Master Sonel.

MsgJp:
理由を聞いても
「これ以上話すとキミのことから忘れそうだ」
とおっしゃるばかりで、俺にはどうにも――
MsgEn:
I asked for a reason, but they just replied, 
"If I say any more, I may forget you."

MsgJp:
すまないけど、ソネル様の様子を
見てきてもらえないか？
MsgEn:
I apologize, but could you go check 
on Master Sonel's state for me?

MsgJp:
なるほど、そういうことだったのか！
無事に事が済んで良かったよ
MsgEn:
I see, so that's what happened!
I'm glad it all worked out.

MsgJp:
まぁ、作戦については
指示を受けた兵たちがなんとかするだろう
MsgEn:
Well, the soldiers instructed about 
the strategy will manage it somehow.

MsgJp:
あ、隊長じゃないか
もしかして、自分の部屋に
くつろぎに来たのかな？
MsgEn:
Ah, it's the captain! 
Are you perhaps here 
to unwind in your room?

MsgJp:
"あること"を研究中でね
隊長にも協力してもらえると助かるよ！
MsgEn:
I'm in the midst of researching 
"something." I'd appreciate 
the captain's assistance!

MsgJp:
さすがは隊長だ！
ではさっそく始めたいんだけど
MsgEn:
That's my captain!
Well, I'd like to get started right away.

MsgJp:
ちょっと準備もあるから
先に<SPOT 1093>へ向かってくれないかな 
ボクもすぐに出発するよ！
MsgEn:
I'm busy with some preparations, 
so please head to <SPOT 1093> 
first. I'll be on my way soon!

MsgJp:
隊長！　こっちこっち！
わざわざこんな所まですまないね！
MsgEn:
Captain! This way, this way! 
I apologize for bringing you 
all the way out to such a place!

MsgJp:
いろいろと実験してるうちに
手元にあるのがなくなってしまってね
MsgEn:
As I was conducting several experiments, 
I found myself running out of what I 
had available at hand.

MsgJp:
隊長にも、探すのを手伝って欲しいんだ
この実験が成功すれば
計画も軌道に乗せられる
MsgEn:
I want you to help me look for it too, 
Captain. If this experiment works, the 
plan can get back on track.

MsgJp: それじゃあ、よろしく頼んだよ！
MsgEn: Well then, I'm counting on you!

MsgJp:
よしよし、これだけあれば
なんとかなりそうだ！
MsgEn:
Good, with this much, 
it looks like we should be fine!

MsgJp:
さっそくキャンプに戻って
実験再開だ！
MsgEn:
Let's return to camp right away 
and continue the experiment!

MsgJp:
ありがとう隊長！
遠慮なく、"自分の部屋"で
モフモフしてくれたまえ！
MsgEn:
Thank you, Captain! 
Don't hesitate to get 
cozy in your room!

MsgJp:
あ、隊長！
今、テレパシーを送っていたところさ！
MsgEn:
Ah, Captain!
I was just sending you a telepathic message!

MsgJp:
ちょっと困ったことがあってね
<STG 1001>へ行こうと思うんだ
MsgEn:
There's something troubling me, 
so I'm thinking of going to 
<STG 1001>.

MsgJp:
事が事だからね
隊長にも一緒に来てほしい
MsgEn:
Considering the circumstances, 
I want you to join me too, Captain.

MsgJp:
"ある計画"に必要な情報があってね
それに関わる案件なんだ
<STG 1001> で待ってるよ
MsgEn:
I possess information essential 
for "a certain plan." 
It's related to the matter at hand.
I'll be waiting at <STG 1001>.

MsgJp:
彼が昨日から戻って来ないんだ
今まで何の連絡もなしに
予定より遅れることはなかった
MsgEn:
He hasn't come back since yesterday. 
There has never been a delay without 
contacting me before.

MsgJp:
もしもの時は――
ここで落ち合うことにしてるから
ボクはここに残らないといけない
MsgEn:
If things go wrong, 
this is where we agreed to meet, 
so I must stay here.

MsgJp:
すまないが、隊長は
最後に目撃された場所へ向かって欲しい
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but I need you to go 
to where the captain was last seen.

MsgJp:
こんなことを頼めるのは隊長しかいないんだ
厄介をかけるけど、頼んだよ
MsgEn:
You're the only one I can rely on for this. 
I know it's a bother, but I'm trusting you.

MsgJp:
もしもの時は――
ここで落ち合うことにしてるから
ボクはここに残らないといけない
MsgEn:
If things go wrong, 
this is where we agreed to meet, 
so I must stay here.

MsgJp:
すまないが、隊長は
最後に目撃された場所へ向かって欲しい
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but I need you to go 
to where the captain was last seen.

MsgJp:
こんなことを頼めるのは隊長しかいないんだ
厄介をかけるけど、頼んだよ
MsgEn:
You're the only one I can rely on for this. 
I know it's a bother, but I'm trusting you.

MsgJp:
あんたは――？
え、ソネル様の！
そうか、助かった
MsgEn:
Who are you――? 
Oh, you're one of Sonel's! 
Got it, that's a great relief.

MsgJp:
情報を手に入れたはいいが
敵に襲われてこのザマだ――
MsgEn:
I got the information, 
but I was assaulted by enemies, 
and now I'm in this state――

MsgJp:
追っ手が近くまで来ている
奴らをなんとかしてくれ！
MsgEn:
The pursuers are getting close.
Do something about them!

MsgJp:
あんた腕が立つんだな！
さすが、ソネル様が寄越しただけのことはある
驚いたよ
MsgEn:
You're quite skilled!
As expected from someone
sent by Master Sonel; I'm impressed.

MsgJp: 奴らさえなんとかなれば後は一人で大丈夫だ
MsgEn:
If we can handle those foes,
I'll be fine on my own after that.

MsgJp:
ソネル様に「"例の情報"が手に入った」
と伝えてくれ！
俺もすぐ戻る――ありがとよ！
MsgEn:
Inform Master Sonel that "the info"
has been acquired! I'll be back shortly―― thanks!

MsgJp:
そうか、敵の追っ手に――
奴らも相当必死ということか
隊長に頼んで正解だったよ
MsgEn:
I see, the enemies are pursuing us――
they must be quite desperate.
It was wise to ask the captain.

MsgJp:
よし！　彼が持ち帰った情報と
研究中の土が完成すれば
アレの"品種改良"が可能なはずさ
MsgEn:
Alright! Now that we have the information
he brought back and the soil to study,
we should be able to "cultivate" that!

MsgJp:
火薬の爆発に耐える固さと小型化が伴えば
《熟成爆弾カボチャ》を使った
"あの計画"がようやく実現できる！
MsgEn:
Now with its miniaturized form and toughness
to endure explosive gunpowder,
we can finally implement "that plan"
using the "Ripened bomb pumpkin!"

MsgJp:
いやぁ、ありがとう隊長！
おかげで助かったよ！
MsgEn:
Well, thank you captain!
You've been a big help!

MsgJp:
覚者、ちょうどいいところに来てくれた――
緊急の頼みがある
MsgEn:
Arisen, you've come just in time--
I have an urgent favor to ask.

MsgJp:
ついさっきのことだ
俺が留守にしていた時を狙ったのか
この屋敷に空き巣が入ったようだ――
<NPC 691>が目撃したらしい
MsgEn:
It just occurred a little while ago. 
It seems they targeted this place while 
I was away, and a burglar broke in―― 
<NPC 691> reportedly saw it happen.

MsgJp:
奴が言うには、犯人は複数犯らしい
侯爵家の宝なんてものならまだしも、万が一
<NPC 681>の罪の痕跡を持ち出されたら
とんでもないことになる
MsgEn:
He mentioned that there are likely several culprits. 
If they only took the marquis' treasure, 
it wouldn't be as bad, but if they 
expose evidence of <NPC 681>'s wrongdoings, 
there will be severe consequences.

MsgJp:
まだ遠くへは逃げていないはずだ
頼む、犯人捕獲に協力してくれ！
MsgEn:
They should not be too far away yet. 
I beg you, assist me in capturing the 
criminals!

MsgJp:
この<STG 474>に盗みに入るとは
世間知らずの間抜けな泥棒か
何らかの意図を持って犯行に及んだ組織犯か――
MsgEn:
Breaking into <STG 474> means 
either a foolish, ignorant thief or 
an organized crime group acting with 
some ulterior motive.

MsgJp:
とにかく、追わないことには始まらない
用意は良いか？
MsgEn:
Regardless, we must pursue them to 
get started. Are you all set?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
泥棒どもはまだ
そう遠くには逃げていないはずだ
急いで捜索しよう
MsgEn:
The thieves likely haven't 
escaped too far. Let's 
quickly begin the search!

MsgJp:
<NPC 691>が言うには
忍び込んだ奴らは、鎧下姿だったらしい
つまり――今は
鎧を着込んで変装している可能性がある
MsgEn:
<NPC 691> mentioned that the 
intruders were in their 
undergarments. So, they 
might be in armor to hide 
their identities now.

MsgJp:
挙動不審な怪しい兵士が、おそらく犯人だ
逃げられる前に、全員捕まえてくれ――
頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
The soldier acting suspiciously
is likely the one responsible. 
Apprehend them all before they can get away―― 
I trust you to handle it.

MsgJp:
まさか、憲兵隊時代を忘れられない
憲兵どもの犯行だったとはな――
MsgEn:
I never thought I'd still 
remember the Military Police days. 
So, it was their crime after all.

MsgJp:
大方、<NPC 681>の証拠を隠滅して
もう一度返り咲かせるつもりだったのだろう
MsgEn:
Most likely, they aimed to 
destroy the evidence of <NPC 681> 
and rise to power again.

MsgJp: 捜査は順調か？
MsgEn: How is the investigation progressing?

MsgJp: まずい、もうあまり時間が無いぞ――
MsgEn: Shit, we don't have much time --

MsgJp: もうダメだ――手遅れだろう
MsgEn: It's no use-- it's probably too late.

MsgJp:
よし
それじゃあ、<STG 461>で落ち合おう
MsgEn:
Okay,
I'll meet you at <STG 461> then.

MsgJp:
そうか――
準備ができたら、声をかけてくれ
あまり時間は無いぞ
MsgEn:
Well--
give me a shout when you're ready
We don't have much time.

MsgJp:
泥棒どもはまだそう遠くへ行っていないはずだ
急いで捜索しよう
MsgEn:
The thieves must not be far away. 
We should quickly start the search.

MsgJp:
挙動不審な怪しい兵士が、おそらく犯人だ
逃げられる前に、全員捕まえてくれ――
頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
The soldier acting suspiciously
is likely the one responsible. 
Apprehend them all before they can get away―― 
I trust you to handle it.

MsgJp:
泥棒はまだ、そう遠くは行っていないはずだ
<STG 461>を捜査しに行こう
MsgEn:
The thieves shouldn't be too far away.
Let's go investigate <STG 461>.

MsgJp: な、なんでしょうか――？
MsgEn: What is it--?

MsgJp:
ひぃぃぃぃっ！！
すみません、勘弁してください！
MsgEn: Eek! I'm sorry, please spare me!

MsgJp:
先輩に脅されてやったんですぅぅ！
命だけは、勘弁して――
MsgEn:
I was forced to do it by my senior! 
Just spare my life, please!

MsgJp:
ひぃぃぃぃっ！！
すみません、勘弁してください！
MsgEn: Eek! I'm sorry, please spare me!

MsgJp:
先輩に脅されてやったんですぅぅ！
命だけは、勘弁して――
MsgEn:
I was forced to do it by my senior! 
Just spare my life, please!

MsgJp:
<STG 474>？
――あぁ、見た見た
あっちに逃げて行ったよ
MsgEn:
<STG 474>?
――Ah, yes, I saw them.
They ran off in that direction.

MsgJp:
あー、くそ！
だから俺は盗賊の変装して
侵入しようって言ったんだ！
MsgEn:
Ugh, damn it! 
That's why I said we should 
disguise ourselves as thieves!

MsgJp:
あ、あんた――覚者さぁん！！
良いところに来たな！
MsgEn:
A-Arisen!! You!!
You've come to the right place!

MsgJp:
大変なことがあってよぉ
この屋敷に――い、いいやとにかく
メフィスさんに聞いてくれ！
MsgEn:
I've got a big problem.
In this mansion--ahh, well anyway,
Go ask Ser Mephis!

MsgJp:
ホント、いいところに来てくれたよ！
危うく俺が駆り出されるところだっ――
MsgEn:
You've really come to the right place!
I'm in danger of being dragged out...

MsgJp:
――い、いいやとにかく
メフィスさんに聞いてくれ！
大変なことがあったんだよ！
MsgEn:
Yeah, well, anyway.
Go ask Mephis!
I'm in a rough spot!

MsgJp:
よぉ、相棒――
ちょうど良いところに来てくれた
MsgEn:
Yo, cuz.
Just the place to be.

MsgJp:
実は、<NPC 681>の部屋を改装しているんだが
ちょっとばかり、資材が足りなくてな
<STG 636>に質の良いのを手配しているから
取りに行こうと思ってる
MsgEn:
Actually, I'm renovating a room for <NPC 681>
and I'm a little short on materials.
Since I've arranged for <STG 636>
to get some good quality stuff,
I'm going to go get it.

MsgJp: よかったら、付き合ってくれないか？
MsgEn: If you'd like, you can join me.

MsgJp:
ありがとな
戦いでも諜報でもない、こんな雑務に
付き合ってくれて――
MsgEn:
I appreciate you sticking with me 
through this tedious work, 
something that's neither combat nor spycraft――

MsgJp:
それじゃあ、<STG 636>で落ち合おう
待ってるぞ
MsgEn:
Alright then, let's meet at <STG 636>. 
I'll be waiting.

MsgJp: 困ったな――
MsgEn: What a predicament...

MsgJp:
――おお、来たか相棒
迷わず来られたか？
MsgEn:
――Oh, you made it, cuz.
Did you find your way without trouble?

MsgJp:
――実はな
ちょうど資材の採取場辺りで
オークとの戦闘があったようで
搬入が遅れているらしい
MsgEn:
――Actually, 
it seems there was a battle with orcs 
near the resource gathering site, 
so the deliveries are delayed.

MsgJp:
だが――
あれが無いと、改装作業が進まないんだ
MsgEn:
But-- without it,
I can't proceed with the renovations.

MsgJp:
なぁ覚者、もし良かったらでいいんだが――
資材が余っていたら、分けてくれないか？
MsgEn:
Hey, Arisen, if it's alright with you,
can you spare some of your excess supplies?

MsgJp:
ちょうど資材の採取場辺りで
オークとの戦闘があったようで
搬入が遅れているらしい
MsgEn:
It seems there was a battle with orcs 
near the resource gathering site, 
so the deliveries are delayed.

MsgJp:
もし資材が余っていたら
分けてくれると助かるんだが――
MsgEn:
If you have any surplus materials, 
I would appreciate it if you could share them.

MsgJp:
おい、これ――
本当に良いのか？
MsgEn:
Hey, is this--
really a good idea?

MsgJp:
ははっ――これで改装作業が進むぞ
ありがとうな、相棒！
お前のおかげで<STG 474>は生まれ変わるぞ
MsgEn:
Haha――
With this, the renovation work will progress.
Thanks, cuz!
Thanks to you, <STG 474> will be reborn.

MsgJp:
と、言ってもいつになるかは分からんが――
気長に待っててくれよな
MsgEn:
Though I can't say when it'll be―― 
please wait patiently.

MsgJp:
相棒――良い所に来たな！
少し気になることがあってな
MsgEn:
Cuz――We've arrived at a good spot! 
There's something I'm curious about.

MsgJp:
実は、<STG 133>へ資材調達に行った
<NPC 691>の帰りが遅すぎるんだ
アイツのことだ
どこかで道草食っているんだろうが――
MsgEn:
The truth is, someone went to <STG 133>
for materials, and <NPC 691> is really late.
Knowing them,
they must be goofing off somewhere――

MsgJp:
万一のことがあっては困る
一緒に探しに行ってくれないか？
MsgEn:
It would be troubling if something happened.
Could you go look for them with me?

MsgJp: やっぱり、お前は頼りになるよ
MsgEn: I knew I could count on you.

MsgJp:
それじゃあ、出かける準備を済ませてくれ
<STG 461>の入口で落ち合おう
MsgEn:
Well then, please get ready to head out.
Let's meet at the entrance of <STG 461>.

MsgJp: ――来たか
MsgEn: ――So, you have come.

MsgJp:
近くに大きな危険はないはずだから
二手に分かれて捜索しよう
MsgEn:
There shouldn't be any major dangers nearby, 
so let's split into two groups for the search.

MsgJp:
俺はメガド内の<NPC 691>が
よく行く場所を当たってみる
お前は、街の周辺を探してみてくれ
MsgEn:
I'll look for the places in Megado that <NPC 691>
frequents.
You can check the area around the city.

MsgJp:
近くに大きな危険はないはずだから
二手に分かれて捜索しよう
MsgEn:
There shouldn't be any major dangers nearby, 
so let's split into two groups for the search.

MsgJp:
俺はメガド内の<NPC 691>が
よく行く場所を当たってみる
お前は、街の周辺を探してみてくれ
MsgEn:
I'll look for the places in Megado that <NPC 691>
frequents.
You can check the area around the city.

MsgJp: あ、あんたは――覚者さん！？
MsgEn: Oh, you are... the Arisen!?

MsgJp:
絶妙なタイミングで来てくれたな！
メガドの周りにオークの残党が潜んでたみたいで
散歩してたら、
うっかり鉢合わせちまったんだ！
MsgEn:
Wow, you really came at the perfect time!
It seems that there were some leftover orcs
lurking around the area of Megado.
While I was taking a stroll,
I accidentally ran into them!

MsgJp: で、今追いかけまわされてるってワケ――
MsgEn: And now they're chasing after me...!

MsgJp:
って、ホラ！
噂をすればまた来たぞ！
MsgEn:
Look! 
Just like I said, here they come again!

MsgJp:
いやー、助かった――
まさか覚者さん、あんたが来てくれるとはな
まさに、"ヒーロー！"って感じだったぜ
MsgEn:
Wow, you really came to my rescue!
I didn't expect to see you, Arisen. It felt like
something straight out of a heroic tale!

MsgJp: で、なんでここに？
MsgEn: So, why are you here?

MsgJp:
へ――メフィスが？
ひぇ！！
MsgEn:
Huh? Mephis is here?
Whoa!!

MsgJp:
お、俺はちゃんと資材集めてたって！
その――ちょっと足をくじいちまったんで
休んでたんだよ
な、メフィスにそう伝えてくれよ
MsgEn:
Oh, I was actually gathering materials!
But, umm, I twisted my foot...
So I was resting.
C-Can you please tell that to Mephis?

MsgJp: 頼むぜ！
MsgEn: I'm counting on you!

MsgJp:
メガドにはいないようだった――
そっちはどうだ？
MsgEn:
It seems they weren't in Megado...
How about over there?

MsgJp:
なっ――
足をくじいただと？
あのバカ！
MsgEn:
Oh...
Did you sprain your ankle?
You idiot!

MsgJp:
全く、手のかかる奴だな――
だが無事なことは分かって良かったな
MsgEn:
Oh, you are quite a handful...
But I'm glad you're safe.

MsgJp:
手伝ってくれて、助かった
――これに懲りず、また訪ねてくれよ
MsgEn:
Thanks for your help and for your assistance.
--Don't let this stop you from visiting us again!

MsgJp:
北部のオークどもに動きがあったようだ――
お前も戦に備えて準備してくれ
MsgEn:
It seems the Orcs in the north are on the move――
You should prepare for battle as well.

MsgJp:
オークとの戦争がはじまったなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
MsgEn:
If the war with the Orcs has begun,
visit me once again and come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦にて戦争が始まるみたいです
レスタニアニュースで確認くださいね
MsgEn:
It looks like the war is starting at Fort Gritten.
Check it out on Lestania News!

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は《中央広場》にいる白衛騎士団の
アランさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit Knight Alan
of the White Guard at the Central Plaza.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦で戦争が始まるらしいですわ
弟は大丈夫かしら、心配だわ
MsgEn:
I've heard there's a war going on at Fort Gritten.
I hope my brother is ok, I'm worried about him.

MsgJp:
まもなく砦で戦がはじまるって本当ですか！？
あー私も覚者さまのようになって
戦場を駆け抜けてみたいな
MsgEn:
Is it true that a battle will soon
take place at the fortress?
Oh, I want to be like you, Arisen,
and charge into the fray!

MsgJp:
もうすぐグリッテンで戦がはじまるそうだ
戦場ではとにかく気を抜くなよ
MsgEn:
They say the battle will start soon in Gritten.
Don't get distracted on the battlefield.

MsgJp:
オークの奴らめ
何度攻め入ろうとも無駄なこと
次も返り討ちにしてくれる
MsgEn:
Those damned orcs!
No matter how many times they try to invade,
I'll beat them back again.

MsgJp:
ヒルデ姉さんには無理するなといわれているけれど
次の戦で戦果を上げて昇進したいと思っているんだ
MsgEn:
I know sister Hilde told me not to push myself
too hard, but I still want to excel in the next
battle and get promoted.

MsgJp:
戦は稼ぎ時でもあるんだ――
思い切って投資すれば
それだけ得られるものも大きいぞ
MsgEn:
War is a great time to make money...
If you take a risk and invest, you can get a lot
in return.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦の防衛は
バートランド平原でも重要な任務だ
MsgEn:
The defense of Fort Gritten is also an important
mission in the Betland Plains.

MsgJp:
優秀な戦果を収めたものには
それに応じた報酬も与えられるので
ぜひ防衛隊に参加してくれ
MsgEn:
Those who achieve outstanding results 
will receive appropriate rewards,
so please join the defense force.

MsgJp:
オークどもがついにグリッテン砦に攻めてきたぞ！
覚者は防衛隊に参加し砦を守ってくれ
MsgEn:
Orcs have finally attacked Fort Gritten!
Arisen, join the defenders and protect the fort!

MsgJp:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
ついに開戦したみたいです
気を付けて立派に戦ってきてください
MsgEn:
It looks like the war has finally started.
Take care and go fight honorably!

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを
確認の上、《中央広場》にいる覚者隊の
アランさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please check
the Lestania News and visit Ser Alan
of the Arisen Corps in the "Central Plaza"!

MsgJp:
覚者さま、弟を戦場で見かけた時は
どうか、そのお力でお守りくださいませ
MsgEn:
Arisen, when you see my brother
out on the battlefield, please, 
use your strength to protect him.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、ついに戦が始まったって聞きました
ご武運をお祈りしていますね！
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, 
I've heard that the battle has finally begun. 
I pray for your good fortune!

MsgJp:
グリッテンの戦況はよく確認して向かうのだ
そうすれば色々見えてくるものもあるだろう
活躍を期待しているぞ
MsgEn:
Make sure to assess the conditions
in Gritten before you go.
It will provide you with valuable insights. 
I expect great things from you.

MsgJp:
オーク相手に情けは無用だ
魔物もろとも斬り捨ててくれる
MsgEn:
Show no mercy to the orcs.
Cut them down along with the monsters.

MsgJp:
君、強そうだね
僕の隊で一緒に戦ってくれよ
MsgEn:
You seem strong.
Fight alongside me in my squad.

MsgJp:
凶悪な魔物は討伐評価も高くなる
倒せる自信があるなら
強敵との遭遇は幸運と捉えるべきだな
MsgEn:
Powerful demons have a higher subjugation rate.
If you're confident you can defeat them,
look upon the encounter with those
formidable foes as a stroke of good luck.

MsgJp:
この戦いで戦果をあげることによって
バートランド平原のエリアポイントも
得ることができる
MsgEn:
By securing victories in this fight, 
you'll also obtain area points for 
the Betland Plains.

MsgJp: 頑張って奮戦してくれ
MsgEn: Please fight bravely and do your best.

MsgJp:
何とか砦を守り切れたな
今は各位の戦果を確認中だ
MsgEn:
We were somehow able to defend the fort.
We are currently confirming each person's
contribution.

MsgJp:
報酬は後に与えられる
確認が終わるまで待っていてくれ
MsgEn:
The rewards will be given later.
Please wait until the confirmation is complete.

MsgJp: オーク軍を退けることができたみたいですね
MsgEn: It seems that we were able to repel the Orc army.

MsgJp:
グリッテンの戦も落ち着いたようですわね
弟も無事でなによりです
MsgEn:
It seems that the battle in Gritten
has also settled down. It is a relief
that my younger brother is safe.

MsgJp:
お怪我はありませんか！？
覚者さまやみんなのおかげで敵を撃退できたこと
すごくうれしく思います――
MsgEn:
Are you injured!?
Thanks to the Arisen and everyone's efforts,
we were able to repel the enemy.
I am ever grateful――

MsgJp:
敵を撃退できて何よりだ
戦場を共にに切り抜けた仲間と
肩を並べて飲む一杯は格別だ！
MsgEn:
I'm glad we were able to fight off the enemy!
It's a special thing to drink a cup of wine
shoulder-to-shoulder with new friends
who've made it through the battlefield together!

MsgJp:
よく頑張ってくれた
皆のおかげで撃退できたのだ
感謝する
MsgEn:
You did well and worked hard.
We were able to repel the enemy
thanks to everyone.
I am grateful.

MsgJp:
はぁーなんとか無事だったけれど
活躍どころじゃなかったよ
MsgEn:
Ah, I managed to make it through safely,
but I didn't really have a chance to shine.

MsgJp:
俺がコツコツ稼いだところで
強い奴等は一度の戦いで
1年分は稼いでいっちまうんだ
MsgEn:
Even if I diligently earn little by little,
the strong ones can earn a year's worth
in just one battle.

MsgJp:
どうだ、戦果は期待できそうか？
俺の活躍も副隊長の目にとまってくれていると
いいんだが――
MsgEn:
What do you think?
I hope my successes have also caught
the attention of the Vice Captain.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦防衛の功績に対し報酬が出ているぞ
各位、保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
A reward is available for your achievements
in defending Fort Gritten.
Please collect it from the Storage Box.

MsgJp:
防衛隊に参加してくれたものだな
こたびの協力に感謝する――
報酬を受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
It seems you joined the defense force.
We appreciate your assistance this time.
Please accept your rewards.

MsgJp:
戦果に応じた報酬が出ているみたいです
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
MsgEn:
It looks like rewards are provided 
according to the battle results. 
Check Lestania News for details.

MsgJp:
先の戦いで功績のあった方には報酬が
出たそうですわ――
MsgEn:
I heard that there was a reward for those
who made a difference in the last battle!

MsgJp:
でも私にとっては弟の元気な姿が
何よりの報酬です
MsgEn:
But for me, the best reward is to see
my brother in good health.

MsgJp:
戦場で活躍したみんなに報酬が
出たみたいですね
MsgEn:
It seems that everyone who performed well
on the battlefield received a reward!

MsgJp:
私もいつか、みなさんの隣りで
活躍できたらなって思うんです
MsgEn:
I dream of being able to contribute
alongside everyone one day.

MsgJp:
先の戦いで手柄に応じた報酬が出た
という話だ
MsgEn:
I heard that rewards were given for your
achievements in the previous battle.

MsgJp:
教官である今の俺にとっては、お前の活躍と
全身に刻み込まれた古傷が一番の誇りよ
MsgEn:
For me, as your mentor,
your success is most important to me.
Furthermore, the litany of ancient scars
on one's body brings me great pride.

MsgJp:
こたびの戦いの戦果に応じた報酬を配布中だ
防衛に参加してくれた全ての者は受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
We are currently distributing rewards based on
the results of the battle.
Please make sure to claim your rewards if you
participated in the defense.

MsgJp:
報酬は出たけれど、これじゃぁまだ姉さんに
報告するわけにはいかないなぁ
MsgEn:
I got the reward, but this isn't enough 
to report back to my sister yet.

MsgJp:
いくら稼いだんだ？
俺にも少しくらい分けてくれよ
MsgEn:
How much did you earn?
You gotta share some of that with me.

MsgJp:
報酬はもう受け取ったのか？
お前の活躍、嬉しいんだけど副隊長の注目が
集まると思うと複雑なんだよなぁ――
MsgEn:
Have you already received your rewards?
I'm happy about your achievements,
but I can't help feeling conflicted when
the Vice Captain's attention is drawn to you.

MsgJp: 油断するな
MsgEn: Don't let your guard down.

MsgJp: 悪くない――その調子だ
MsgEn: Not bad -- that's the way.

MsgJp: 目の前の敵に集中するんだ
MsgEn: Focus on the enemy in front of you.

MsgJp: 切り込むぞ！
MsgEn: Let's cut them down!

MsgJp: よし、ここは制圧した
MsgEn: Okay, we're in control here.

MsgJp: それで良い、次に向かうぞ！
MsgEn: Excellent, let's move on!

MsgJp: 新手の敵だ、注意しろ！
MsgEn: It's a new enemy, beware!

MsgJp: 今こそ名をあげる時だ――
MsgEn: Now is the time to make a name for yourself--

MsgJp: 相変わらずの臭いだな
MsgEn: The stench is still the same as always.

MsgJp: 今日こそ決着を付けてくれる！
MsgEn: Today is the day to settle this!

MsgJp: 逃がしたか――
MsgEn: Did they escape?

MsgJp: 覚者の命、全て狩り取ってくれるわ
MsgEn: I will take the lives of all Arisen.

MsgJp: 覚者の命は値千金！　奪え！
MsgEn: The life of an Arisen is invaluable! Seize it!

MsgJp: 今日はここまでだ
MsgEn: This day shall be your last!

MsgJp: まさか――この――俺が――
MsgEn: I can't believe... that I...

MsgJp: ほら、よそ見しない！
MsgEn: Hey, keep your eyes on the prize!

MsgJp: はやくやっちゃって！
MsgEn: Let's end this quickly!

MsgJp: こっちにまわさないで！
MsgEn: Don't bring it over here!

MsgJp: さぁ、大掃除の開始よ！
MsgEn: Alright, it's time to start mopping up!

MsgJp: その調子その調子！
MsgEn: Keep it up, keep it up!

MsgJp: 良い感じ良い感じ！
MsgEn: Looking good, looking good!

MsgJp: ちょ、ちょっと――頼むわよ！
MsgEn: Wait, wait a moment... please!

MsgJp: これって大変じゃない！？
MsgEn: Isn't this quite difficult?!

MsgJp: こんなの聞いてないわよぉ
MsgEn: I didn't ask for this!

MsgJp: ほらほらお願い頑張って！
MsgEn: Come on, come on, please do your best!

MsgJp: 残念――せっかく調子でてきたのに――
MsgEn: What a shame—just when I was getting into it.

MsgJp: 覚者の命、全て狩り取ってくれるわ
MsgEn: I will take the lives of all Arisen.

MsgJp: これは楽しめそうだな、褐色の女戦士よ
MsgEn: This seems promising, warrior.

MsgJp: 覚者の命は値千金！　奪え！
MsgEn: The life of an Arisen is invaluable! Seize it!

MsgJp: ほう――その細腕でやるな
MsgEn:
Well - you've got some real skills
with those skinny arms of yours.

MsgJp: 今日はここまでだ
MsgEn: This day shall be your last!

MsgJp: おまえの力では俺は倒せぬわ
MsgEn: You can't beat me with your own strength.

MsgJp: まさか――この――俺が――
MsgEn: I can't believe... that I...

MsgJp: うがあぁぁぁぁぁぁ――
MsgEn: Ughhhhhh--

MsgJp: 気を抜くなよ
MsgEn: Don't let your guard down.

MsgJp: 良い動きだ！
MsgEn: Good move!

MsgJp: 落ち着いて仕留めるんだ！
MsgEn: Stay calm and finish them off!

MsgJp: さあ！全ての敵を切り倒せ！
MsgEn: Okay! Cut down every enemy!

MsgJp: この調子で駆け抜けるぞ！
MsgEn: Push through at this pace!

MsgJp: よくやった、付いてこい！
MsgEn: Well done, follow me!

MsgJp: 新手の敵だ、突撃するぞ！
MsgEn: It's a new enemy. We're going to charge them!

MsgJp: 来たぞ、集中しろ！
MsgEn: Here they come, concentrate!

MsgJp: ほう――大将のお出ましだ
MsgEn: Ho—the general is here

MsgJp: こいつは手強いな
MsgEn: This one is tough.

MsgJp: 逃げ足の速い奴だ
MsgEn: They're fast on their feet.

MsgJp: おっとっと
MsgEn: Oops!

MsgJp: 敵の動きをよく見るんだ――
MsgEn: Watch your enemy's movements--

MsgJp: 無理するなよ――
MsgEn: Don't push yourself too hard...

MsgJp: さーて、どうなることやら
MsgEn: Well, let's see what happens.

MsgJp: 怪我はないか？
MsgEn: Are you hurt?

MsgJp: 上出来だね
MsgEn: Well done.

MsgJp: なるようにしかならんか
MsgEn: It can't be helped.

MsgJp: ここは覚悟の決め時か――
MsgEn: This is the time to decide――

MsgJp: まだおわりって訳じゃぁないだろう？
MsgEn: It's not the end yet, is it?

MsgJp: なかなかやるじゃないか
MsgEn: You've got some skills.

MsgJp: よくやった、深追いする必要はない――
MsgEn: Well done, there's no need to press further――

MsgJp: 覚者の命、全て狩り取ってくれるわ
MsgEn: I will take the lives of all Arisen.

MsgJp: 会いに来てやったぞ、金色の戦士よ
MsgEn: I have come to meet you, golden warrior.

MsgJp: 覚者の命は値千金！　奪え！
MsgEn: The life of an Arisen is invaluable! Seize it!

MsgJp: 楽しませてくれる
MsgEn: You're providing some entertainment.

MsgJp: 今日はここまでだ
MsgEn: This day shall be your last!

MsgJp: 次を心待ちにしているぞ
MsgEn: I'm looking forward to the next one.

MsgJp: まさか――この――俺が――
MsgEn: I can't believe... that I...

MsgJp: 存分に楽しませてもらったぞ――
MsgEn: I've thoroughly enjoyed myself――

MsgJp: オラオラオラオラ！
MsgEn: Ora ora ora ora!

MsgJp: こっちは任せろ！
MsgEn: Leave it to me!

MsgJp:
《竜の巣》の魔物は
レスタニアのそれとは訳が違う
特にドラゴンはなおさらだ！
MsgEn:
The monsters of the "Dragon's Nest"
are different from those of Lestania,
especially the dragons!

MsgJp:
今のうちに夢とロマンで
心を満たしておくといい！
恐怖でチャンスを逃すことのないようにな
MsgEn:
Fill your heart with dreams and romance
while you still can!
Don't let fear keep you from taking chances.

MsgJp:
開催期間になったら
再度、俺の元に参加を申し出てくれ！
MsgEn:
When the event is held again,
please come back and participate!

MsgJp: ゼルキンさんが船の準備をはじめたそうよ
MsgEn:
It seems that Zerkin has started
preparing the ship.

MsgJp:
危ないことはしないでほしいけれど
夢を追いかけることは素敵なことですよね
MsgEn:
I don't want you to do anything dangerous, but...
it's nice to follow your dreams, isn't it?

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを
確認の上、神殿内の《港洞》の船上にいる
ゼルキンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information,
please check the Lestania News and visit Zerkin,
who is on board the ship in the "Cave Harbor" 
within the Temple.

MsgJp:
船長はバカほど海とロマンを愛してるんだ
おっとあんたもその口だったけか
MsgEn:
Captains love the sea and romance
as much as any fool.
Oh wait, you're one of them, aren't you?

MsgJp: ま、俺もそうだがよ――
MsgEn: Well, I'm the same, you know...

MsgJp:
うん、まもなく船の修理もおわり出航の準備も
整いつつあるよ
MsgEn:
Yes, the repairs on the ship will be
finished soon and preparations for departure
are also coming together.

MsgJp:
君も《竜の巣》に渡るつもりなら十分に仕度すると
いいね
MsgEn:
If you're looking cross over
to the "Dragon's Nest" as well,
you'd better be well-prepared.

MsgJp:
《竜の巣》に向かう船の準備で
港もいつもより活気がありますよね
MsgEn:
When the ships start getting ready to head to the
"Dragon's Nest", the Harbor is always more lively
than usual.

MsgJp:
《竜の巣》では覚者の力をもってしても
まともに太刀打ちできんだろう
MsgEn:
Even with the power of Arisen,
one may not be able to stand a chance
in the "Dragon's Nest".

MsgJp:
だが、上手くやれば名を上げられる
上手くやれなくても誇れる挑戦を手にできる
心が決まれば、船はいつでも出そうではないか！
MsgEn:
But if you do well,
you can make a name for yourself.
If you don't, you can still get a challenge
that you can be proud of.
If your heart is set on it,
the ship can always set sail any time!

MsgJp:
挑もうという覚悟と準備ができたなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてくれ
MsgEn:
If you've got the mettle to take it on,
enter the mission without delay!

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
ほら、ロマンが呼んでいるぞっ！！
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the Temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
ついに洋撃船が出航するそうですよ！
港の方々は大忙しです
MsgEn:
It seems that the Western Expedition ship
will finally set sail!
The people at the port are very busy.

MsgJp:
覚者さまも行かれるのですか？
無事帰ってきてお話聞かせてくださいね
MsgEn:
Will you be going, Arisen?
Please return safely and tell us your story.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを
確認の上、神殿内の《港洞》の船上にいる
ゼルキンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information,
please check the Lestania News and visit Zerkin,
who is on board the ship in the "Cave Harbor"
within the Temple.

MsgJp:
さぁ、洋撃船はいつでも出航できるぜ
《竜の巣》に渡りたいモノ好きどもがいればの
話だがな――
MsgEn:
Come on, our ocean-going ship is ready to sail.
If there are those who want to cross over to the
"Dragon's Nest," this may be your opportunity...

MsgJp:
けど、あんた
もしも行って戻ってこれたら
話ぐらいは聞かせてくれよな
MsgEn:
Though, when you come back,
at least tell us your story.

MsgJp:
いよいよ出航だね――
僕はこの時の港の雰囲気がたまらなく好きなんだ
MsgEn:
It's finally time to set sail, huh――
I really love the atmosphere of the port at this time.

MsgJp: 覚者さまも《竜の巣》に向かうのですか？
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, are you also heading to the Dragon's
Nest?

MsgJp:
あそこに行くのは
よほど腕の立つ奴かただの命知らずだって
船乗りの兄はよく言っていました
MsgEn:
My brother, who is a sailor, used to say that the
only people who go there are either very skilled
or just plain daredevils.

MsgJp:
今は《竜の巣》での戦果の確認中だ！
働いた分の報酬は出るから、そう焦るな
MsgEn:
I am currently verifying the results
of our battle at the Dragon's Nest!
Don't worry, you will receive your rewards for
the work you've done, so there's no need to rush.

MsgJp: 《竜の巣》で大きな戦果をあげた人がいるようです
MsgEn:
It seems that someone has achieved great results
at the Dragon's Nest.

MsgJp:
もしかして、覚者さまが大活躍されたんですか？
ゼルキンさんからの発表が待ち遠しいですね
MsgEn:
Could it be that the Arisen
has made a great contribution?
I can't wait for Zerkin's announcement.

MsgJp: 船長が《竜の巣》で戦果をあげたものを確認中だ
MsgEn:
The captain is currently confirming
the achievements at the Dragon's Nest.

MsgJp:
《竜の巣》なんざぁ俺は行きたくないが
あそこでく繰り広げられた冒険譚を聞くのが
楽しみなんだよ
MsgEn:
I don't want to go to the "Dragon's Nest",
but I'm looking forward to hearing about the
adventures that took place there.

MsgJp:
今回もまた船が派手に壊れちゃったなぁ
さっそく修理に必要な見積もりを出さなくちゃ
MsgEn:
Once again,
the ship has been spectacularly destroyed.
I must promptly request an estimate for repairs.

MsgJp:
船が無事に帰ってきてうれしいです
いったいどんな冒険が繰り広げられたのでしょうか？
MsgEn:
I am glad the ship returned safely.
I wonder what kind of adventure unfolded there?

MsgJp:
ああ、今回の取り分は送っておいたぞ！
保管ボックスから確認してくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, I've already sent your share for this time!
Please check it from the Storage Box.

MsgJp:
あそこはとんでもなく危険なのにまた行きたくなる
そうだろう？　覚者よ！
MsgEn:
It's a terribly dangerous place there, isn't it?
Yet you still want to go there, Arisen!

MsgJp:
また次の航海を思い描けば船の修理にも
自ずと精が出るというものだ！
がはははは！
MsgEn:
Just imagining the next voyage ahead
brings vigor to the ship repairs as well!
It's natural for spirits to rise, isn't it?
Gahahaha!

MsgJp:
おぅ、丁度、戦果の集計がついたとこだ
これはあんたの報酬だ、受け取りな
MsgEn:
Oh, just in time.
The results of the battle have been tallied.
This is your reward. Take it.

MsgJp: 覚者さまのお名前も載っていると良いですね
MsgEn:
It would be nice to have the name of the Arisen
included as well.

MsgJp:
ゼルキンさんからのお知らせが
レスタニアニュースに載っています
MsgEn:
There is an announcement from Zerkin
in the Lestania News.

MsgJp:
あんた、ドラゴンや魔物はどうだった！？
今度一杯ご馳走するから
ゆっくり話を聞かせてくれよな
MsgEn:
How were the dragons and monsters?!
I'll treat you to a drink next time,
so take your time and tell me your story.

MsgJp:
船長は手に入れた報酬を
毎回、次の航海の資金にしている
MsgEn:
The captain uses the rewards obtained
each time as funds for the next voyage.

MsgJp:
ほんとあきれるけど

MsgEn: It's truly astounding, but I admire that passion.

MsgJp: 奴らを倒せば残り時間が延長されるぞ
MsgEn: Defeating them will extend the remaining time!

MsgJp: おお！　ついにエルダードラゴンのお出ましだ！
MsgEn:
Oh! The Elder Dragon has finally made an
appearance!

MsgJp: 覚者たちよ、戦果を目指すなら討伐だ！
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you aim for achievements in battle,
focus on defeating it!

MsgJp:
南の森で恐ろしい魔物を見たという
噂が広がっている
MsgEn:
People have been talking about seeing a terrible
monster in the southern forests.

MsgJp:
まもなく討伐が開始されるだろう――
おまえも参加するならば
準備しておくといい――
MsgEn:
The hunt will begin shortly.
If you're joining in too, be prepared...

MsgJp:
討伐が開始されたなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
MsgEn:
Once the hunt has begun,
visit me once again and come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

MsgJp:
ローガンさんが討伐準備をしている魔物は
異界を渡る力を持つそうです
MsgEn:
The monster that Ser Logan is preparing
to subdue seems to have the power
to travel through different realms.

MsgJp:
多くの覚者さまの力が必要になるため
是非協力してあげて下さいね
MsgEn:
We will need the power of many Arisen for this,
so please lend us your assistance.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は
《商店区》にある白衛騎士団の詰所にいる
ローガンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit Ser Logan
at the White Knights' Headquarters
in the Shopping District.

MsgJp:
そういえば、《古の祭祀場》に
強い竜力の淀みが発生していることは
知っている？
MsgEn:
By the way, were you aware
that there is Dragon Force accumulating
in the "Ancient Place of Rituals"?

MsgJp:
オールドグロウエントか、それより
もっと恐ろしい何かか――
MsgEn:
Old Grove Ent, was it?
Or something even more terrifying?

MsgJp:
白衛騎士団も確認に動いているそうよ
神殿の騎士団本部にも
情報を取りに行ってみて
MsgEn:
The White Knights are working to confirm this.
You can also go to the Knights Headquarters
in the Temple to get more information.

MsgJp:
対峙した者の話によれば
相手はケタ違いの化け物らしい
MsgEn:
According to those who have confronted it,
our adversary is of a different caliber.

MsgJp:
命を落とすことのないよう
十分気をつけて戦ってくれ
MsgEn:
Please fight with utmost care,
should you perish.

MsgJp:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
ローガンさんが討伐隊を
動かし始めたみたいです
MsgEn: Ser Logan looks to be preparing for a hunt.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》にある白衛騎士団の詰所にいる
ローガンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please check the Lestania
News and visit Ser Logan at the White Knights'
Headquarters in the "Shopping District".

MsgJp:
《古の祭祀場》に、恐ろしい魔物が
姿を現したの！
いつものエントなど比較にならない
強大な魔物よ
MsgEn:
A terrible monster has appeared
in the Ancient Place of Rituals!
It's a mighty monster that can't be compared to
the usual Ent...

MsgJp:
今、神殿の騎士団本部が中心となって
討伐隊を組織しているわ
MsgEn:
Right now the headquarters of the Temple Knight
Order is leading the way in organizing a hunting
party.

MsgJp:
貴方もぜひ力を貸して！
このミスリウのためにも――
MsgEn:
Please lend your strength as well!
For the sake of Mysree, too...

MsgJp:
討伐に参加してくれた
多くの勇気ある戦士達のおかげで
あの化け物を退けることができた
MsgEn:
Thanks to the brave soldiers who participated in
the subjugation, we were able to repel that
monster.

MsgJp: 心から礼を言わせてもらうよ
MsgEn: I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart.

MsgJp:
森に現れた魔物を
退けることができたそうです
MsgEn:
We hear that they were able to repel the monster
that appeared in the forest.

MsgJp:
レスタニアニュースでも
取り上げられていますよ
MsgEn: It has also been featured in Lestania News.

MsgJp:
先の森の
魔物討伐における報酬を支給している
MsgEn:
The reward for the forest monsters hunt is
currently being distributed.

MsgJp:
まだのものは
保管ボックスから受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
Please retrieve the items that are still in the
storage box.

MsgJp:
先の戦闘評価が終わっている――
報酬を支給するので受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
The previous combat evaluation has ended. Please
collect the reward.

MsgJp: 先の魔物討伐の戦果が発表されています
MsgEn:
The outcome of the previous enemy subjugation has
been announced.

MsgJp:
報酬も支給されていますので
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
MsgEn:
Rewards are also being paid, so please check it
out on Lestania News!

MsgJp: 永遠不変をうそぶく厚顔なる白竜と覚者よ――
MsgEn:
Oh, the arrogant white dragon, who claims to be
eternal—, and you, Arisen――

MsgJp:
永遠なるは我が輝き、不変なるは我が志し――
思い知るがよい――
MsgEn:
My radiance is eternal, my determination
unwavering. You shall come to know this.

MsgJp:
うつろう世にしがみつく
哀れなる白竜と覚者よ――
MsgEn:
Oh pitiful White Dragon and Arisen, clinging to
this fleeting world...

MsgJp:
白がくすみ人が絶えても我が輝きは不滅――
この黄金こそが永遠の象徴――
MsgEn:
Even if the white fades and people disappear, my
brilliance is everlasting.
This gold is a symbol of eternity.

MsgJp: 世界は我が物と信じて疑わぬ白竜と覚者よ――
MsgEn:
O, white dragon who believes the world is theirs
without doubt, and you, Arisen――

MsgJp:
教えてやろう
貴様らが信じる理のもろさを――
MsgEn:
Allow me to show you the fragility of the world
order you believe in.

MsgJp:
伝説で語り継がれた黄金に輝く竜が
空で待っているそうだ
MsgEn:
It is said that a legendary dragon, shining with
golden light, awaits in the sky.

MsgJp:
相手は想像を絶する化け物だ
今から準備をはじめておくといい――
MsgEn:
The enemy is an unimaginable monster.
It's best to start preparing now--

MsgJp:
討伐が開始されたなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
MsgEn:
If the hunt has begun, visit me once again and
come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

MsgJp: 黄金の竜の討伐準備が進んでいます
MsgEn:
Preparations for the defeat of the Golden Dragon
are underway.

MsgJp:
一匹の魔物の討伐とは思えない
大部隊による長期戦になるそうです
MsgEn:
It doesn't seem it'll be like defeating a single
monster.
It appears it will be a long-term battle waged by
a large force.

MsgJp:
それでも――
伝説の竜を打ち倒すことなんて
できるのでしょうか
MsgEn:
Even so...
Is it possible to strike down the legendary
dragon?

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は《商店区》の
海辺の見える竜の礎前にいる
ハンコックさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit Mr. Hancock in
the Shopping District near the Dragon's Portcrystal
with a view of the seashore.

MsgJp: いよいよ生ける伝説、黄金竜との決戦だ
MsgEn:
It's finally the decisive battle with the living
legend, the Golden Dragon.

MsgJp:
この戦いは奴が倒れるまで戦いは引き継がれる
最後まであきらるな
MsgEn:
This battle will not be over until they are
defeated.
We must not give up, no matter how long it takes.

MsgJp:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
黄金の竜の討伐遠征が
始まっています
MsgEn:
The expedition to defeat the Golden Dragon has
begun.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》の海辺の見える竜の礎前にいる
ハンコックさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please check Lestania News
and visit ser Hancock in the Shopping District
near the Dragon's Portcrystal with a view of the
seashore.

MsgJp: 戦果の報告をまとめているところだ
MsgEn:
I'm in the process of summarizing the results of
the battle.

MsgJp:
報酬はその後支給するので
待っていてくれ
MsgEn:
The reward will be distributed afterwards, please
wait.

MsgJp: 遠征が終わったようですね
MsgEn: It seems that the expedition has come to an end.

MsgJp: 本当にあの黄金の竜を倒せたのでしょうか――
MsgEn: Did we really manage to defeat the Golden Dragon?

MsgJp:
先の黄金竜討伐に対する
報酬を支給中だ
MsgEn:
Rewards for the recent defeat of the Golden
Dragon are now being distributed.

MsgJp: 保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
MsgEn: Please retrieve it from the Storage Box.

MsgJp:
黄金竜討伐の戦果に対する
報酬を支給する
MsgEn:
The reward for the successful elimination of the
Golden Dragon.

MsgJp: 協力に感謝する――ありがとう
MsgEn: We appreciate your cooperation. Thank you.

MsgJp:
先の遠征における戦果が
発表されています
MsgEn:
The results of the recent expedition have been
published.

MsgJp:
報酬も支給されていますので
レスタニアニュースより確認くださいね
MsgEn:
Rewards are being paid, so please check it out in
Lestania News!

MsgJp: 完全なる者たちは何処に――
MsgEn: Where are the perfect ones...

MsgJp:
我に完全を与える主よ――
ここにはいないのか――
MsgEn:
O Lord, grant me perfection—
Is it not here—

MsgJp:
戦いは永遠を知る方便――
空しさなど覚えるものか――
MsgEn:
Battle is the means to know eternity――
Why remember emptiness――

MsgJp:
私の予感だが、ほどなくレスタニアに
暗雲が立ち込めようとしている
MsgEn:
I have a feeling that soon, a dark cloud will
loom over Lestania.

MsgJp:
これは凶悪な魔物があらわれる前兆だ
気をつけるといい
MsgEn:
This is an omen of the coming of a vicious demon.
Be careful.

MsgJp:
魔物が姿を現したならば
再度、私の元を訪れて
討伐隊への参加を期待しているぞ
MsgEn:
If the monsters show themselves, I hope you'll
visit me again and join the hunt team!

MsgJp:
レスタニアで恐ろしい気配を感じたという
噂が流れています
MsgEn:
Rumors are circulating of a frightening presence
in Lestania.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は
《商店区》にいるコーネリアさんを
お訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit ser Cornelia
in the "Shopping District"

MsgJp:
つい最近、レスタニアで
恐ろしい魔物の気配を感じたという
報告が舞い込んできたのだ
MsgEn:
We have recently received reports of a terrifying
demonic presence in Lestania.

MsgJp:
恐るべき魔力の息吹を持つという噂もある
十分に気を付けるといい
MsgEn:
There are rumors that it possesses a breath of
fearsome magical power. It would be wise to be
extremely cautious.

MsgJp:
挑める準備と覚悟ができたなら
さっそく討伐隊に参加してくれ
ファビオ様は重大な用ゆえ
私が窓口を任されている
MsgEn:
If you are prepared and ready for the challenge,
please join the hunting party right away.
Lord Fabio has urgent matters to attend to, so I
have been entrusted with handling the
arrangements.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどれほどなのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
Also, you should check the ranking boards located
throughout the Temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
恐るべき異界の魔物の気配が
確認されているそうです
MsgEn:
It seems that the presence of fearsome enemy
creatures from the Other World has been confirmed.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》にいるコーネリアさんを
お訪ねください
MsgEn:
For detailed information, please check Lestania
News, then visit Ms. Cornelia in the Commercial
District.

MsgJp:
何とか退けることができたようだな
さすがだ、覚者よ
MsgEn:
It seems that you were able to somehow fend it
off. Truly impressive, Arisen.

MsgJp:
戦果を集計しているところだ
報酬支給はもう少し時間をくれ
MsgEn:
We are currently tallying the results of the
battle. Please give us a little more time for
reward distribution.

MsgJp:
ただいま魔物と交戦した方々の戦果を
集計しています
MsgEn:
We are currently calculating the results of those
who have fought monsters just now.

MsgJp: 発表まで今しばらくお待ちください
MsgEn:
Please wait a little longer until the
announcement.

MsgJp:
魔物討伐の報酬が支給されている
保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
The reward for defeating the enemies has been
paid. Please accept it from the Storage Box.

MsgJp:
先の戦闘評価が終わっている
報酬を支給するので受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
The previous combat evaluation has ended. Please
collect the reward.

MsgJp: 先の魔物討伐の戦果が発表されています
MsgEn:
The outcome of the previous enemy subjugation has
been announced.

MsgJp:
報酬も支給されていますので、
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
MsgEn:
Rewards are also being paid, so please check it
out on Lestania News!

MsgJp: オマイラ――覚えとけよ！
MsgEn: You all―― remember this!

MsgJp: おいおい――調子にのるなって
MsgEn: Hey hey, don't get carried away.

MsgJp: 腐ってもやっぱり覚者か！？
MsgEn:
Even if you're rotten, you're still an Arisen,
huh!?

MsgJp:
２つ以上のミッションには
エントリーできないぞ
MsgEn: You can't enter more than one mission!

MsgJp:
先にエントリーしている方のミッションを
終わらせるか、エントリーを取り消して
再度こちらに来るんだ
MsgEn:
Either finish the mission you've already entered,
or cancel your entry, then come back again.

MsgJp:
ボルド大坑道へ調査にいったゲルト団長から
緊急指令が届いているんだ
MsgEn:
I've got an urgent order from Commander Gerd, who
went to the Volden Large Tunnels to investigate.

MsgJp:
準備を整えたら、ミッションエントリーをしてくれ
俺も共に向かうぞ
MsgEn:
Once you're ready, please enter the mission.
I will also join you.

MsgJp:
――先のミッションで物凄い戦果を
挙げたそうだな
MsgEn:
I heard you achieved an amazing victory in the
previous mission.

MsgJp:
特別なアビリティを与えるよう言われている
ふん――役に立つと良いがな
MsgEn:
I've been told to give you a special Augment.
Well, I hope it proves useful.

MsgJp:
ボルド大坑道でのミッション、ご苦労だったな
――助かった、礼をいう
MsgEn:
Thank you for your hard work on the Volden Large
Tunnels mission. I am grateful for your help.

MsgJp:
戦果についての確認が終わり次第
保管ボックスにて報酬を受け取れるようになる
受け取りを忘れるなよ
MsgEn:
After the results have been confirmed, you will
be able to receive your reward in the Storage Box.
Don't forget to pick it up.

MsgJp: 魔赤島にアルタード・ズールが現れた
MsgEn: An Altered Zuhl has appeared on Bloodbane Isle.

MsgJp:
こんなことを覚者に頼むのも癪だが――
かなり切迫した状況だ
MsgEn:
Even though it pains me to have to burden the
Arisen with this, it's a very desperate situation.

MsgJp:
駐屯地が危険にさらされている――
すぐに準備を整え、ミッションエントリーを
して欲しい
――食い止めてくれ
MsgEn:
The garrison is in danger!
Join the mission, now, please.
...Stop them!

MsgJp:
――貴君は他のミッションの元に
パーティを組んでいるな
MsgEn: You are in a party for another mission.

MsgJp:
先にそちらのミッションの参加予定を
取り消し、あらためてここに来てくれ
MsgEn:
Please cancel your participation in the mission
over there first, and then come here again.

MsgJp:
今回も何とか魔物を退けたな
――我々への協力、感謝する
MsgEn:
Once again, we managed to drive away the monsters.
Thank you for your cooperation.

MsgJp:
ミッションの戦果が発表された者から
保管ボックスより順次報酬を渡すぞ
MsgEn:
We'll distribute rewards sequentially from the
storage box to those whose mission achievements
have been announced.

MsgJp:
先の戦いについて
多くの戦果を挙げた貴君に対して
特別なアビリティが送られることになった
MsgEn:
As a reward for your many
accomplishments achieved in that last battle,
you will receive a special Augment.

MsgJp: ぜひ受け取ってくれ――
MsgEn: Please accept it with gratitude--

MsgJp:
"シェドレアン大神殿"での問題を
解決してくれたみたいね！
アデルドナハからも、礼をいっておいてくれと
言われたよ――
MsgEn:
It seems like you solved the problem
that beset the Shadolean Great Temple!
Adair Donnchadh told me to thank you...

MsgJp:
今は戦果の分析中だから
もうしばらく待っていてちょうだい
MsgEn:
I'm in the process of analyzing the war results,
so you'll have to wait a while longer.

MsgJp:
今回のミッションでは物凄いはたらきを
してくれたみたいね！
MsgEn: You did a tremendous job on this mission!

MsgJp:
戦果の報酬として、シークレットアビリティが
付与されるよ
受け取ってちょうだい
MsgEn:
As a reward for your battle results,
you will receive a Secret Augment.
Please accept it.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦でのウォーミッションは終了した
現在、各個人の戦果を確認しているところだ
MsgEn:
The war mission at Dacreim Fortress has ended.
We are currently checking each individual's
achievements.

MsgJp: 集計が終わるまで、しばらくの間待っていてほしい
MsgEn:
Please wait a while for the tally
to be completed.

MsgJp:
あんたの持っているDPと引き換えに
品物を提供しよう
ラインナップを確認してみてくれ
MsgEn:
In exchange for the DP you possess,
I can offer these goods.
Please take a look at the lineup.

MsgJp:
一部のアイテムには、条件を満たした者にしか
与えられない特別なアイテムが存在する
MsgEn:
There are special items that can only be given
to those who meet the requirements.

MsgJp:
戦いにおいて、どれだけの成果を達成したかにより
提供できるアイテムも変わってくるぞ
MsgEn:
The items that can be obtained through battle
depend on the achievements made therein.

MsgJp: 敵陣を制圧完了！（残り３ヶ所）
MsgEn: Enemy stronghold successfully captured! (3 left)

MsgJp: 敵陣を制圧完了！（残り２ヶ所）
MsgEn: Enemy stronghold successfully captured! (2 left)

MsgJp: 敵陣を制圧完了！（残り１ヶ所）
MsgEn: Enemy stronghold successfully captured! (1 left)

MsgJp: 砦２階を塞ぐ扉が開いた！
MsgEn: The door blocking the 2nd floor of the fortress has opened!

MsgJp:
覚者を狙う大砲が増強された！
戦況が悪化していく――
MsgEn:
The large-bore cannons that target Arisen
have been strengthened!
The situation is getting worse...

MsgJp:
敵軍設備増強を防いだ――
戦況ゲージが回復した！
MsgEn:
Prevented enemy reinforcement.
War status gauge has recovered!

MsgJp: 覚悟と兆し
MsgEn: Resolutions and Omens

MsgJp:
オーク軍の襲撃を受けているグリッテン砦に向かい
レオ、イリスとともに援軍として戦闘に参加する
MsgEn:
Fort Gritten is being raided by the Orc army.
Join the battle with Leo and Iris as reinforcements.

MsgJp: 覚悟と兆し
MsgEn: Resolutions and Omens

MsgJp:
オーク軍の襲撃を受けているグリッテン砦に向かい
レオ、イリスとともに援軍として戦闘に参加する
MsgEn:
Fort Gritten is being raided by the Orc army.
Join the battle with Leo and Iris as reinforcements.

MsgJp: レオ、イリスと共にグリッテン砦に向かう
MsgEn: Head to Fort Gritten with Leo and Iris

MsgJp: レオ、イリスと共にグリッテン砦に向かう
MsgEn: Head to Fort Gritten with Leo and Iris

MsgJp: 砦内のすべてのオークを討伐する
MsgEn: Defeat all Orcs in the fort

MsgJp: 砦内のすべてのオークを討伐する
MsgEn: Defeat all Orcs in the fort

MsgJp: 横たわる神
MsgEn: The Slumbering God

MsgJp:
謁見の間に集まった主要人物らと話し
覚者としての立場と使命を理解する
MsgEn:
Talk to the important people in the Audience Chamber.
Learn about your position and mission as an Arisen.

MsgJp:

そのあたりで騎士団の団員が、物思いの顔で

On the outskirts of the street,
there's a crumbling castle wall, right? 
It seems that a member of the Knights Order
has been standing there with a pensive look for a while. 
Recently, they've been conducting preliminary
investigations of suspicious places
and patrolling the houses in the area. 
I wonder if something has happened.

MsgJp:
結婚を約束していた彼女が姿を消してからもう半年
僕の心はまだ癒えず、思い出の場所であるあの草原に
昨日も出向いてたんです
そしたらふと、丘の向こうから何か声が聞こえて――
あれは魔物の唸り声だったのか、それとも――
いえ、僕の妄想だってことぐらいわかっているんです
MsgEn:
It has been half a year since she, 
whom I had promised to marry, disappeared.
My heart is still not healed, 
so I went to that grassland, a place of memories.
Yesterday, I went there again,
And then, suddenly, 
I heard a voice from beyond the hill-- 

Was that the growl of a monster, or... 
No, I know it's just my imagination.

MsgJp:
いままで家族全員、つつましくやってきました
多くを望まず、日々祈りを欠かさず――
それなのに、この３日だけで６回ですよ！
魔物の影に追われ、声に怯え、気配に身を竦ませ――
いったい私たちがどんな罪を犯したのですか！
もうこの地に留まる事はできません
MsgEn:
We have lived modestly with our whole family until 
now, desiring little and never missing a prayer.
Yet, in just these three days, six times!
Chased by the shadows of monsters,
terrified by the sounds, 
shivering at every presence—
what sin have we committed?
We can no longer stay here.

MsgJp:

毎回、当番の日に限って帰り道でヘンな影を見たり
物音を聞いたりするんだ
こないだは旅人が魔物に襲われたって言うし――
こういうのは、もっとケンカの強いヤツが行くべき
なんだ
MsgEn:
Fetching water is important, 
but I'm starting to hate it.
Every time it's my turn, I see strange shadows
or hear odd noises on the way back.
The other day, 
a traveler was attacked by monsters, they say.
This kind of job should be handled 
by someone tougher.

MsgJp:
あれは旅の資金が尽きたうえ雨に降られて
やむなく地下に潜ったときの話だ
深く立ち入らなければ安全だろうと思っていたら
奥の方から唸り声みたいなものが聞こえて――
だんだん近づいて来たんだ
驚いて、思わず外へ飛び出しちまったよ
MsgEn:
When our travel funds ran out and we were caught in the rain, we had no choice but to take refuge underground. 
I thought it would be safe as long as we didn't go too deep, 
but then I started hearing a growling noise from further in――
and it kept getting closer. 
I was so startled that I ended up rushing outside.

MsgJp:
私ほどの音楽家となると
曲作りのインスピレーションを求める貪欲さが違う
魔物たちの咆哮こそ、創作の糧としてふさわしい
生命のうねり、暴虐のこだま、絶望の響き！
さあ、今日もあの魔窟へ出かけるとしよう
妙なる調べのためなら、この命捧げようとも！
MsgEn:
When it comes to musicians like me, 
the greed for seeking inspiration in 
songwriting is different. 
The roars of monsters are indeed worthy as the 
nourishment for creation. 
The surging of life, the echo of violence, 
the resonance of despair! 
Now, let us venture into that abyss once again today. 
Even if I have to dedicate my life, I will do so 
for the sake of these strange melodies!

MsgJp:
古傷がうずくのは、やつらが近づいてきたしるしだ
数十年騎士をやっていれば、目や耳よりも

だがその精度も、ここのところめっきり落ちた
いまもやつらを近くに感じているが、これを信用して
いいものか――引退を考える時期、なのかもな
MsgEn:
The throbbing of old wounds is a sign that they 
are drawing near. 
After decades as a knight, I can discern it more 
clearly than my own eyes or ears. 

But even that precision has noticeably 
declined as of late. 
I still sense them approaching, 
but can I trust this... 

Is it perhaps time to consider retirement?

I won't let them escape anymore.

I swear on this blade, I will settle this.
Prepare yourself!

When I wake up before dawn and look at the still 
dark sky in the east, it's really beautiful. 
But yesterday, 
I got scared and immediately went back home. 
Because there was something like a big shadow 
that passed by right nearby――

MsgJp:
先日、海辺で一人ぽつんとたたずむ女性がいたから
つい心配になって声をかけたんです
そのときは不審者に間違われて逃げられてしまったん
ですが――まあ、あそこにずっと居て

MsgEn:
The other day, 
there was a woman standing alone by the seaside, 
so I couldn't help but worry and approached her. 
At that time, she mistook me for a suspicious 
person and ran away... 

Well, it's better for her to be there all alone 
than to be attacked by real bandits, I suppose.

手持ちが尽きて宿に泊まれなくなったので
やむなく海岸にある廃船で休もうとしたんです
そしたら必死の形相の男性がやってきて
「そこに入るな、危ないぞ！」って――
何か大切なものでも隠してるんですかね？
それともまだあの船、使うつもりなんでしょうか
MsgEn:
Since I ran out of money, 
I couldn't stay at an inn, 
so I reluctantly tried to rest in an abandoned 
ship on the coast. 

And then a man with a desperate look on his face 
came up to me and said, 
"Don't go in there, it's dangerous!"... 
I wonder if he's hiding something important 
there? Or maybe he still intends to use that ship?

If I wasn't injured like this, maybe I could have 
helped with carrying luggage or 
searching for items. 

Well, I guess neither of us had much luck.

MsgJp:

子供ふたりを連れてさ、貝でも拾ってやろうかって
海岸近くまで行ったのよ
そしたら茂みの中か、岩場の影か――とにかく物影

MsgEn:
That's right, listen up!
I took my two children and went near the coast,
thinking of picking up some shells for them.
But then, 
in the bushes or the shadows of the rocks—
somewhere in the darkness—
there was something staring at us.
It gave me the creeps, so we hurried back home.

I will honestly confess.
Just a moment ago, around Breya Coast,
I found traces of an enemy...
But I got scared and retreated.
It's truly shameful
that despite wanting to overcome my timidity
and become an Arisen,
I am still so cowardly.

MsgJp:

so we moved to this place with a relatively 
stable climate where we can see the sea.
But never did we expect to encounter such a 
terrifying thing.
We were so shocked that we ran away in a panic,
our bodies trembling with fear.
I can't relax and rest properly here.

MsgEn:
The reason the Knights dislike us is because 
there are ignorant Arisen who become complacent 
in their position. 

In that regard, Gurdolin has a different spirit. 
That man is a true Arisen who never lacks in 
training and ambition. 
If you have the opportunity, 
it would be good to speak with him. 
There is no better example to learn from than him.

Those who shy away from jumping into danger 
and rely on others, 
how will they ever amount to anything? 
What is the purpose of "living forever"? 

Well, it's troublesome when someone recklessly 
plunges in without thinking ahead, though.

and was in despair.
For some reason, I couldn't find an opportunity
to approach her and greet her.
I wonder if she was able to

troubled by frequent monster attacks.

by the leaders on the ground. 
I want to support them as much as possible, but 
manpower shortage is a serious issue everywhere. 
In these circumstances, 
it is necessary to cooperate with the Arisen.

nervous at the sound of cave-ins or landslides. 
A delayed judgment can cost one's life. 
However, the sound I heard yesterday... 
While it was indeed the sound of dirt, 
it felt different from a landslide. 
I had a bad premonition, 
so I quickly withdrew from work.

It seems that there is a rift to the Other World,

that I've been sensing since the other day is 
connected to this? How intriguing.

near here for about a month.

イヴァンの奴、かなり怒ってたな

In the <NAME AREA>,

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【 敵出現：夜 】</COL>
夜も明けきらない森の中で
それは恐ろしい、魔物の叫び声が聞こえたわ
あたしたちは生きた心地もなく
夜道を駆けるように、村に帰ったの、ええ本当に
森で採取した、野草も茸も何もかも放り投げてね
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Enemy appears during: Night】</COL>
In the forest, before daybreak, 
we heard a dreadful monster's scream. 
We ran back to the village as if
fleeing for our lives, 
abandoning all the wild herbs
and mushrooms we had gathered.

but I definitely saw it with my own eyes. 
Such a monster, appearing in the forest—
I'm really worried about what might happen next.
We must drive the monsters away 
while we still can.

MsgJp:
その昔、ここらの森は多くの民から愛される
立派な領主が治めていたと聞きました
ところがある日、部下の裏切りにあい
森で命を落としたそうです
その無念が今では呼び水となり
あの場所に魔物を呼び寄せているそうです
MsgEn:
Long ago, this forest was loved by many
and ruled by a noble lord.
But one day, he was betrayed by his subordinates
and lost his life in the forest.
His resentment now serves as a catalyst,
attracting monsters to that place.

MsgJp:
あの魔物の肉は、強力な毒にも
病気を治す妙薬にもなり得る貴重な物です
多くの病で苦しんでいる、森の子供たちを救える
なくてはならない材料です
どうか、ご討伐願いたい
MsgEn:
That monster's flesh is a valuable resource,
capable of becoming a powerful poison or a
miraculous cure for diseases.
It is essential for saving the children of the
forest suffering from many ailments.
Please, I ask you to defeat it.

MsgJp:
近頃ミスリウ森林の奥からずいぶん獲物が
減ったと思ったら、どうもやばい竜が
居付きやがったって話だ
どうもどっかの遺跡の奥をねぐらに選んだらしいが
この状態が続いちゃ俺達狩人は商売あがったりだ
誰かなんとかしてくれねぇかなぁ
MsgEn:
Recently, I've noticed a significant drop in game
in the depths of the Mysree Forest, and it turns
out that a dangerous dragon has taken up residence
there. It seems it chose some ancient ruins as
its lair. If this situation continues, hunters like
us will be out of business.
I hope someone can do something about it.

That man is always bold with his plans,
but he tends to pass off the dangerous roles to 
others and can be somewhat stingy, which is a flaw.
Well, if you're interested, 
it might be worth joining in.

I admit I was foolish to go 
to such a dangerous place— 
but everything I saw was 
filled with malice. 
That's how it felt to me— 
I swear I'll never go near 
such a place again. 
Curiosity? That can always be 
shattered against the weight of life.

can often be dependable in crucial situations.

swiftly retake it, leading to ongoing strife.
Then we'd face more battles to regain it――
It's just a baseless fear, but there's no assurance
it won't become reality.
